name: Meeting assistant
description: Live feedback from an agent during a meeting.
changelog: Shows what it's doing: the menu bar's start screen and status window use this app's own steps and wording.
notice: What's said in this meeting leaves your Mac. Tell the people in it.

reads: the transcript and speaker names of the Superwhisper meeting you're recording, started in the last 15 minutes or after you press Start
sends: transcript text to the canopy session it opens, and so to the agent's model provider
the whole transcript to your private Meetings page in Canopy, when a meeting ends by itself

brief.label: What kind of feedback do you want?

from_start.label: Include what was said before you pressed Start

open_chat.label: Open the chat in my browser when people start talking

checks.label: Superwhisper's command-line tool is set up
checks.fix: Install Superwhisper's command-line tool so that ~/.local/bin/superwhisper exists, then try again.

checks.label: Superwhisper is open
checks.fix: Open Superwhisper, then press Start again.

steps: {agent} listens and comments in a chat while you talk.
End the meeting in Superwhisper and the transcript is saved to your Meetings page.

states.starting:
Starting
Checking for your Superwhisper meeting.
states.waiting_for_your_meeting:
Start your meeting in Superwhisper
It's picked up as soon as it's recording.
states.joined_your_meeting:
Found your Superwhisper meeting
Waiting for the first words.
states.waiting_for_words:
Recording
Waiting for the first words.
states.listening:
Listening
{agent} comments in the chat when something's worth saying.
states.meeting_ended:
Meeting ended
The transcript is saved to your Meetings page.
states.no_new_speech:
Stopped after 10 quiet minutes
The transcript is saved to your Meetings page.
states.saved:
Saved to your Meetings page
Open it from Meetings to ask {agent} for follow-up.
states.save_failed:
Meeting ended, but it couldn't be saved
Canopy didn't answer. The chat still has what was sent.
states.save_refused: Meeting ended, but Canopy refused to save it
states.no_meeting_started:
No meeting was started
Start one in Superwhisper, then press Start again.
states.stopped_by_you:
Stopped
Nothing more was sent, and nothing was saved.
states.killed_by_stop_command:
Stopped
Nothing more was sent, and nothing was saved.
states.source_gone:
The meeting was deleted in Superwhisper
What hadn't been sent was dropped, and nothing was saved.
states.max_minutes:
Stopped at the 2-hour limit
Nothing was saved.
states.canopy_refused:
Canopy refused the chat
Check the agent you chose under Configure.
